notes.title: Hardest Harvest Demo is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
After months of development, we're proud to announce this playable demo for Hardest Harvest! 
In this prototype version you'll be able to experience the core gameplay of our game, trying the shooting mechanics and power-up system. Survive as long as you can, and try to reach the end!

We hope you'll enjoy your time playing Hardest Harvest Demo, and if you do so please fill the fast survey before quitting. It will help us shape the game in the best way possible and deliver a more exciting final experience.

It's time to reap your veggies, farmers!
